title: Include or require path built from a variable in php — review required
description: include or require is given a variable path rather than a literal. If any part of that path comes from a request, the attacker selects which local file is executed as PHP, or points the include at a remote URL when allow_url_include is enabled. The rule flags the dynamic include; the source of the variable is a review decision.
remediation: Map user values onto a fixed allowlist of include paths and never concatenate request text into include or require.
limitation: Lexical: matches include/require/require_once/include_once followed by a variable within the statement.
